description: Na₃Li₄Th₆F₃₁ crystallizes in the trigonal P3c1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted pentagonal pyramidal geometry to six F atoms. There are three shorter (2.30 Å) and three longer (2.32 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted q6 geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.75 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are three shorter (2.31 Å) and three longer (2.33 Å) Na-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four F atoms. There are a spread of Li-F bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.05 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are three shorter (1.98 Å) and three longer (2.08 Å) Li-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Th sites. In the first Th site, Th is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Th-F bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.60 Å. In the second Th site, Th is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Th-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.61 Å. There are eleven inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Th atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Th atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Li and one Th atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent Th atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Th atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li and two equivalent Th atoms. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Th atoms. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Th atoms. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Th atoms. In the tenth F site, F is bonded to one Na, one Li, and two Th atoms to form distorted corner-sharing FNaLiTh₂ tetrahedra. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one Th atom to form distorted FNaLi₂Th tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FNaLiTh₂ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FNaLi₂Th tetrahedra.
